title: Common OpenAPI response envelope
x-verification: Envelope fields code/message/request_id/data appear in every response schema of the official OAS (bundle 0.1.7). The OAS carries no required flags; requiring code/message/request_id is a project decision (every OAS response declares them). data shape is per operation (schemas/ops/).

code.description: 0 = success is the common convention; the OAS only says 'success or failure status code'.
